name: neo-linoleum
author: neostryder (RPGM Tools)
description: Bundled freely-licensed graphics tile packs. Registers the Original, Adam Bolt, David Gervais, and Nomad tilesets so a graphics mode can be picked in Options (not only via ?tiles=/?graf= URL). Shockbolt is deliberately excluded (bespoke licence). The mod itself is OFF on a fresh install, like every mod; enable it and the four packs appear in Options -> Graphics, where ASCII is still the default until you pick one. Fully removable: disable it and the game is ASCII-only again.
